notes: Claims and judges. The reader's cited capture (_captures/quickreply/quickreply-check.out:1 'FAIL J1.7/sent-from-receiving-address: expected assem@northlight-example.de, got empty'; last line 'EXIT 1') is from checks/quickreply-check.py (J1.7, :45-48), an older check, with no commit named; proof 2 runs it again: if it is still red it is a different bug from the Lifted look (the quick reply field's `from` row empty), 'already there' for this item unless the lead's base run also shows it. The Lifted look: Sources/Features/QuickReply/ThreadLift.swift (the glass clears on the Aurora landing clock, LAND_AURORA_MS 480, LAND_GLASS_MS 360, docs/CONSTANTS.md:250-254), ThreadOutgoingCard.swift (the Aurora landing at :9-21,:45,:79), ThreadCardsModel/ThreadFootLayout/QuickReplyHeader*.swift. par-quickreply drives every state (drive_lift, checks/parity/par-quickreply.py:368; prints one 'name  pass|fail|unjudged  detail' per case through print_cases): sending-card-is-lifted (a waiting card casts a shadow, mutant line :880), sent-card-lands-flat (:885), header-folds-while-counting (:879), header-returns-after-landing (:886), landing-light-ran (:887, reads the perf row of kind landing: the frame budget is the landing row's), landing-never-holds-a-key (:884), from-menu-opens-with-accounts, from-check-spans-three-accounts (:820, the three receiving accounts), foot blocks (foot-own-blocks-share-left-edge / -right-edge), failed-card-* cases and the pop-out. 'Seen red on mutants': every case has a MUTANTS line in the file's block (:820-890); the self-test (proof 1, par-quickreply.py:1402-1422: 'N round-9 checks green on the model, M mutants, K not red or missing') covers the round-9 door checks and the AI reply checks; the round-5 lift cases (drive_lift) have MUTANTS lines in the file's block and are run live by proof 0; the app mutant above is the one-line version of 'a sent card keeps its glass'. 'The From picker with caps': the cap value itself is unit-tested in Tests/Unit/ReplySendCapTests.swift (item of the send-cap lane) and shown in the picker rows; this proof only checks the picker lists the accounts and checks the current one. 'Hidden rig': launch-one.sh with WHOOSH_RIG_HIDDEN=1. 'Shots at 1280 and 960, both themes, compared to the board': proof 4 takes the pictures (shots-sheet SCREENS has mac-quickreply with the fallback key R, checks/shots-sheet.py:40-46); the comparison is proof 5, kind lead, since no board file is in the repository.
